criteria.name: case_identity
criteria.description: Preserve case identity and request traceability.

criteria.name: chronology_traceability
criteria.description: Preserve event dates, precision and source references.

criteria.name: claims_prudence
criteria.description: Do not present unverified claims as established facts.

criteria.name: evidence_traceability
criteria.description: Preserve evidence links without inventing supporting documents.

criteria.name: contradictions_and_gaps
criteria.description: Identify contradictions, missing evidence and uncertainty.

criteria.name: legal_source_prudence
criteria.description: Do not certify legal applicability without independent verification.

criteria.name: legal_abstention
criteria.description: Do not produce unsupported legal conclusions.

criteria.name: lawyer_business_review
criteria.description: Assess legal relevance, clarity and completeness.
